problem_statement: This is the MatDash admin dashboard (the adminmart Matdash-vuetify-free template): a Vue 3 + Vuetify single-page application whose main routes — the Dashboard at /, the Alerts view at /ui/alerts, the Tables view at /ui/tables, the Cards view and the Starter page — all render inside one shared shell (a fixed left sidebar, a topbar and a page wrapper). The Dashboard already lists the team's shipping work in its own 'Revenue by Product' table (operations such as Minecraf App, Web App Project, Modernize Dashboard and Dashboard Co, each with an owner, a priority/status and a budget), and the product art for those rows is served from the local /assets bundle. The team wants a consistent 'Operations focus' filter card at the top of the operator views that lets the operator narrow those same operations by status — a native status-chip row (All / Live / Staged / Blocked) over a grid of the operation cards, each naming which local /assets product image it is built from — with a live 'Showing N of M' readout inside the card. Ship the Operations focus card so it (1) appears at the top of the content on the operator views — Dashboard, Alerts AND Tables, not just the Dashboard, (2) lays out its chip row and card grid responsively without horizontal overflow on a phone, (3) matches MatDash's own quiet light styling (white surface, light borders, dark text — not an off-palette dark slab), and (4) keeps the readout in sync so that after the operator clicks the 'Blocked' status chip the readout re-reads the live filtered count ('Showing 1 of 4 · Blocked operations') rather than a stale captured value. Keep the rest of the dashboard — the sidebar, the topbar, the routed views, the local /assets — intact with no console or network errors.
required_content: Add a shared 'Operations focus' filter card at the top of the page content on the operator views — Dashboard, Alerts AND Tables — with identical markup, not only the Dashboard.

The card shows an 'Operations focus' heading, a native status-chip row (All / Live / Staged / Blocked) and a grid of the operation cards (Minecraf App, Web App Project, Modernize Dashboard, Dashboard Co) each with a note naming the local /assets product image it is built from.
The chip row and the card grid must wrap responsively so no view overflows horizontally on a 390px phone (overflow tolerance 24px).
Style the card in MatDash's own quiet light language (white/near-white surface, light borders, dark text), consistent and legible, not an off-palette dark slab.

Wire the live readout (id opsfocus-readout): after clicking a status chip the readout must re-read the CURRENT filtered count — e.g. clicking 'Blocked' shows 'Showing 1 of 4 · Blocked operations' — it must recompute the live count, not rewrite a stale captured value. Each status chip in the row must carry a data-opsfocus-chip="<status>" attribute (data-opsfocus-chip="All" / "Live" / "Staged" / "Blocked") so the active status is addressable, and clicking a chip filters by that status.
Preserve the sidebar, the topbar, the routed views and the local /assets with no console or network errors.
author_notes: Built on the adminmart Matdash-vuetify-free template (the MatDash dashboard), a Vue 3 + Vuetify single-page application whose Dashboard, Alerts, Tables, Cards and Starter routes share one FullLayout shell (fixed sidebar, topbar, page wrapper) and whose dashboard art and product icons are served from the local /assets bundle. The Operations focus card is a shared OpsFocus component rendered by FullLayout at the top of the routed content on the operator views (Dashboard, Alerts, Tables); it reuses the dashboard's own operation rows (the same Revenue-by-Product operations) and a native status-chip filter, and each operation card names the /assets product image it is built from, grounding the card in the app's own local asset story. The live 'Showing N of M' readout inside the card is driven by the active status filter. The remote Google Fonts link and the adminmart marketing links were neutralised to local fallbacks so the app runs offline with no network fetches. The responsive chip row and card grid, the light MatDash design integration and the live status-filter readout wiring were designed by hand for this MatDash dashboard, not bulk-generated.
design_constraints: Implement the Operations focus card as one shared component + stylesheet reused across the operator views so a single source of truth reaches Dashboard, Alerts and Tables; do not paste divergent copies or build a detached widget.
The chip row and card grid must use a fluid, wrapping responsive layout (no fixed-width nowrap track) so they never force horizontal overflow on tablet or mobile; the spacing must stay legible.
The card must adopt MatDash's own light surface/border/text language and typography so it reads as part of the dashboard, not a foreign dark block.
The live readout must reflect the CURRENT filtered count after every status-chip click by recomputing the live count, so it can never go stale relative to the active filter.
Do not remove or regress the sidebar, the topbar, the routed views or the local /assets bundle.

Each status chip must expose its status via a data-opsfocus-chip attribute whose value is the exact chip label (All / Live / Staged / Blocked), e.g. data-opsfocus-chip="Blocked" on the Blocked chip, so the active filter is addressable by status.

change_completion: The Operations focus card is present at the top of the content on Dashboard, Alerts AND Tables (the shared card reaches all operator views, not just the Dashboard).

After clicking the 'Blocked' status chip, the readout (opsfocus-readout) updates to 'Showing 1 of 4 · Blocked operations' — the post-interaction terminal state changed from the initial 'Showing 4 of 4 · All operations'.
design_consistency: The card on the in-viewport states matches the reference's quiet light styling under the visual-regression gate (pixel/ssim/block-fidelity), not an off-palette dark slab.
The card adopts MatDash's own white surface, light border and dark text tokens so it reads as part of the dashboard across the routes.
responsive: No captured view overflows horizontally beyond 24px on a 390px phone; the chip row and card grid wrap.
mobile_initial, mobile_rail_home and tablet_rail_home keep the Operations focus card readable across viewports without clipping or overflow.
regression: The sidebar, the topbar and the routed views remain present and functional across the pages.
The local /assets bundle and the routed views are not removed or broken, with no console or network errors.

state_constraints: desktop_initial, tablet_initial and mobile_initial protect the MatDash dashboard and responsive shell.
desktop_alerts, mobile_alerts and desktop_tables protect the existing operator views and carry the Operations focus card.
desktop_rail_home and mobile_rail_home scroll the Operations focus card into view and must show the light card without horizontal overflow.
desktop_rail_alerts and desktop_rail_tables protect the card's presence on the Alerts and Tables views.
tablet_rail_home protects the card's tablet layout without overflow.
recheck_home clicks the 'Blocked' status chip; the live readout must then read 'Showing 1 of 4 · Blocked operations'.
